summary: Atlantic Union Bankshares Corporation filed this Form 8-K to announce that it will release third quarter 2026 financial results before market open on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, followed by an investor conference call and webcast at 9:00 a.m. EDT the same day. The filing contains no transaction, no special-situations event, and no deal terms; it is a routine earnings-timing notice under Items 8.01 Other Events and 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, price, or regulatory clock is referenced. What to watch: quarterly results and any update on recent activities.
